title: AI-Powered Credit Card Fraud Detection using CTGAN-Based Synthetic Data Generation
summary: An internship project applying CTGAN synthetic data generation to address class imbalance in credit card fraud detection, augmenting fraud samples before training Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers. It imports CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata from the sdv library and runs it to generate synthetic fraud transactions.
affiliations: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology (NIET); GNCIPL
evidence: AI_CreditCardCTGAN.ipynb: 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' then 'ctgan = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata, epochs=100)'
